tools.name: get_flight_fare_calendar
tools.description: Reads stored one-way fares per adult for a route and month, with observation dates and source. Missing days have no stored price. It does not start searches or predict future fares.

tools.name: get_flight_price_insight
tools.description: Reads a stored Google Flights price assessment and historical series for one departure day and one adult. A missing insight means insufficient stored data. It is not a live fare or a prediction.

tools.name: record_travel_interaction
tools.description: Records a widget navigation action without contact details, booking references or URLs.

tools.name: search_hotels_live
tools.description: Starts a live hotel search for a city and date range. Prices come from Agoda, Booking.com, Traveloka, Trip.com, Hotels.com and Airbnb, plus direct rates from TravelOpen partner hotels. Returns a session ID; poll_search_results returns the results as they arrive. Optional filters narrow the results by hotel name, area or total price for the stay. Prices depend on the party: it defaults to 2 adults in 1 room, and the result states the party searched and flags when it was defaulted. When the city or dates are missing, the result is a question for the user instead of a search; the stay dates searched are echoed back for confirmation.

city.description: City or broad destination, e.g. 'Da Nang'. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

checkIn.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD), today or later. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

checkOut.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD), after checkIn. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

adults.description: Number of adults (default 2). Prices depend on it.

children.description: Number of children sharing the room (default 0). Child ages determine family quotes; sources without verified occupancy support are omitted.

childAges.description: Age of each child, 0–17. Family quotes are limited to sources that accept this occupancy; unsupported sources are omitted.

hotelName.description: Optional hotel-name filter when the user names a specific property

area.description: Optional ward, neighbourhood, beach or landmark within the city, e.g. 'Shoreditch' with city 'London'. A place the search recognises lists the hotels within a few km of it; otherwise it filters the city's hotels by their address.

priceMin.description: Minimum total price for the whole stay (not per night), in priceCurrency.

priceMax.description: Maximum total price for the whole stay (not per night), in priceCurrency.

priceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of priceMin/priceMax (USD, EUR, VND, …); defaults to the currency of the UI language.

amenities.description: Optional amenities every hotel shown must have, as at least one of its sites lists them: pool, beach, breakfast, parking, gym, spa, airport_shuttle, kitchen, family (family rooms).

queryText.description: Optional short excerpt of the current request, used only to detect the UI language; it is not stored or forwarded.

tools.name: poll_search_results
tools.description: Returns the current results of a hotel search session started by search_hotels_live: hotels with their price from each source, and TravelOpen direct listings with the propertyId that get_hotel_detail and get_hotel_info take. Results can be partial while the search runs; status reads 'completed' once every source has answered.

offset.description: Skip first N hotels for pagination (default 0)

hotelName.description: Optional override for the hotel-name filter captured at search time

area.description: Optional override for the area filter captured at search time

priceMin.description: Optional override for the minimum-price filter

priceMax.description: Optional override for the maximum-price filter

priceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of priceMin/priceMax; defaults to the UI language's currency

tools.name: search_flights_live
tools.description: Starts a live flight search for a route and date, with an optional return date. The two directions are priced as separate one-way tickets. Fares come from Agoda, Trip.com, Booking.com, Traveloka, Kiwi.com, Mytour.vn, Vietravel Airlines and Google Flights. Origin and destination are 3-letter IATA airport codes (for example SGN, HAN, DAD). Returns a session ID; poll_flight_results returns the results. When the route or date is missing, the result is a question for the user instead of a search.

origin.description: Departure airport IATA code, e.g. 'SGN'. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

destination.description: Arrival airport IATA code, e.g. 'HAN'. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

departureDate.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD, today or later. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

returnDate.description: Optional return date YYYY-MM-DD. Results include a separate one-way search for the return direction; a pair is not one combined round-trip ticket.

queryText.description: Optional short excerpt of the current request, used only to detect the UI language; it is not stored or forwarded.

tools.name: poll_flight_results
tools.description: Returns the current results of a flight search session started by search_flights_live: outbound and return options with airline, flight number, times, stops, the cheapest fare and every site's fare with its booking link (offers). Results can be partial while the search runs; status reads 'completed' or 'failed' when it ends.

limit.description: Maximum results per direction. Zero returns the full structured page for the widget.

tools.name: get_hotel_detail
tools.description: Prices and availability for one TravelOpen direct-listed hotel over a date range, with its photos, amenities and room types, each room with its rate plan and total price. Takes the propertyId from search results (source 'OPENTRAVEL_DIRECT'), or a hotel name plus city for a known direct listing. get_hotel_info returns the same hotel's static facts without dates.

propertyId.description: TravelOpen propertyId UUID from search results (opentravelResults[].propertyId).

hotelName.description: Fallback name for a confirmed TravelOpen direct listing when propertyId is unavailable

city.description: City of the hotel — required when resolving by hotelName.

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or later.

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkIn.

queryText.description: Optional short excerpt of the current request, used only to detect the UI language; it is not stored or forwarded.

tools.name: get_ota_hotel_detail
tools.description: Full detail (rooms, live prices, facilities, photos, reviews) from Booking.com for one named hotel over a date range, for requests about a single hotel rather than a whole city (search_hotels_live lists a city). The name is resolved through the city's listings, so it takes the hotel name together with its city; a Booking.com URL from an earlier result skips that lookup. TravelOpen direct listings are covered by get_hotel_detail. The fetch is live and takes up to about two minutes; under heavy load it can return not-found.

hotelName.description: Name of the hotel, e.g. 'Mercure Danang French Village Bana Hills'. Required unless propertyUrl is given.

city.description: City of the hotel, used to resolve the name, e.g. 'Da Nang'. Required with hotelName.

propertyUrl.description: Booking.com property URL from an earlier result (hotel.prices.booking.url); skips the name lookup.

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or later.

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkIn.

childAges.description: Age of each child. Child-aware room detail is limited to Booking.com and Agoda app adapters.

queryText.description: Short excerpt (one sentence at most) of the guest's latest message in their own words, used only to detect the reply language; it is not stored or forwarded. It carries no names, contact details or other parts of the conversation.

language.description: Optional UI language. Indonesian (id) cannot be detected from text, so for Indonesian this is how the language is set.

tools.name: compare_hotel_link
tools.description: Compares prices for the one hotel behind a link from Booking.com, Agoda, Traveloka, Trip.com, Hotels.com or Airbnb: finds the same hotel on the other sites and lists each site's price for the whole stay, cheapest first, with a link to each. The dates and guests in the link are used when it has them, otherwise checkIn, checkOut and adults. Share links and links inside pasted text work too. Takes about 10-30 seconds.

url.description: The hotel link as the user pasted it, e.g. 'https://www.agoda.com/radisson-hotel-danang/hotel/da-nang-vn.html'.

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, used when the link has no dates.

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD, used when the link has no dates.

adults.description: Number of adults, used when the link does not say (default 2).

childAges.description: Age of each child for supported family quotes.

queryText.description: Short excerpt (one sentence at most) of the guest's latest message in their own words, used only to detect the reply language; it is not stored or forwarded. It carries no names, contact details or other parts of the conversation.

language.description: Optional UI language hint. Only used when queryText gives no signal.

tools.name: check_booking_status
tools.description: Returns the current status of a booking request (waiting for the hotel, confirmed or cancelled) by the confirmation code request_booking returned.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Sends a booking request for a room at a TravelOpen partner hotel. Nothing is charged and no room is held: the hotel confirms the request by email, and the guest pays at the property on arrival. There is no payment step, now or later. Takes the room and rate from get_hotel_detail and the guest's name, phone number and email; when any of these is missing, the result asks for it and, in clients that show widgets, opens a form for it. One request covers several rooms of the same room type (roomCount), with adults and children counted across all of them; each call is a separate request with its own code, so rooms of one type booked call by call reach the hotel as unrelated requests. Returns one confirmation code for the whole request.

checkIn.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or later.

checkOut.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkIn.

roomCount.description: How many rooms of this room type the guest wants (default 1). All of them go in this one request, under one confirmation code.

quoteId.description: Server-issued quote identifier for the selected room, dates and party, from get_hotel_detail. Valid for ten minutes.

confirmedByUser.description: Explicit guest confirmation of the exact room, dates, party, contact details and total.

adults.description: Number of adults across ALL rooms of the request — at least one per room

children.description: Number of children across ALL rooms of the request (default 0)

guestName.description: Full name of the primary guest. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

guestPhone.description: Guest phone number; the hotel calls it to confirm the request. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

guestEmail.description: Email address the confirmation is sent to, as the guest gave it; it cannot be changed after the request is sent. When omitted, the result asks the user for it.

totalAmount.description: Total amount for ALL rooms in the property's base currency: the room's price for the stay × roomCount

currency.description: Currency of totalAmount, as quoted by get_hotel_detail for the chosen room.

queryText.description: Short excerpt (one sentence at most) of the guest's latest message in their own words, used only to detect the reply language; it is not stored or forwarded. It carries no names, contact details or other parts of the conversation.

language.description: Optional response language hint. Only used when queryText gives no signal.

tools.name: get_hotel_info
tools.description: Static facts about a TravelOpen direct-listed hotel, with no check-in or check-out date required: photo gallery, property description, address, facilities (parking, pool, pets and so on), check-in and check-out times, the house cancellation policy, and each room type's description, floor area, capacity, photos and in-room facilities. Carries no prices and no availability — get_hotel_detail covers those for a specific date range. Takes the propertyId UUID from search results.

propertyId.description: TravelOpen propertyId UUID from search results (opentravelResults[].propertyId).

queryText.description: Optional short excerpt of the current request, used only to detect the reply language; it is not stored or forwarded.

tools.name: get_cancellation_policy
tools.description: Returns the cancellation terms for one rate plan at a TravelOpen partner hotel: whether it is refundable, the free-cancellation window, the refund percentage, a plain-language summary and, given the check-in date, the exact free-cancellation deadline. Takes the propertyId and the ratePlanId from get_hotel_detail.

propertyId.description: TravelOpen propertyId UUID from search results

checkInDate.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD — required to compute the exact free-cancel deadline

queryText.description: Short excerpt of the guest's request, used only to pick the reply language.

language.description: Reply language. Falls back to queryText, then English.

tools.name: request_cancel_token
tools.description: First of two steps to cancel a booking. Emails a single-use cancellation token to the address on the booking, given its confirmation code and that same email address. Nothing is cancelled, charged or refunded by this step. The token expires after 24 hours and works once; cancel_booking completes the cancellation with it.

guestEmail.description: Guest email address — must match the booking primary guest email

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Second of two steps to cancel a booking: cancels it and starts any refund due. Irreversible. Requires the confirmation code and the single-use token that request_cancel_token emailed to the guest; a missing, expired or already-used token is rejected. get_cancellation_policy shows the refund terms that apply.

cancelToken.description: Single-use cancellation token from the email request_cancel_token sent to the guest.
